title: Final clean, deburr and dry-fit the case halves

notices.text: Both sealing flanges must be perfectly clean and perfectly dry — any oil film and the sealant will not bond. Final wipe with brake cleaner or acetone on a lint-free cloth, then do not touch the flange with bare hands. Chase every threaded hole with a thread chaser (not a cutting tap) and blow out the chips. Dry-assemble the halves once with the crank in, without sealant, to confirm nothing binds and everything clears.

steps.text: Final clean, deburr and dry-fit the case halves.
